Student work 2: false power property; the rule concerns products, [[m4]], but the sum [[m5]] does not simplify (with [[m6]]: [[m7]]). Student work 3: error in the direction of variation; [[m8]] is decreasing, but the coefficient [[m9]] is negative and reverses the direction of variation, so [[m10]] is increasing (for example [[m11]]). Student work 4: conclusion without unit; the model and the calculation are correct, but the conclusion must be given in context: after [[m12]] years, the machine is worth about [[m13]] euros. Have students say aloud which piece of data triggers the choice of method.
